verdict.rationale: Fathom lists a "Conversational meeting assistant" and ships an official MCP server and Claude connector, so users can work with their meeting data in natural language through ChatGPT, Claude and other MCP clients. The evidence only shows natural language used to access and query meeting data, not to operate the product itself (recording settings, sharing, CRM sync, webhooks). Missing for 10: documented natural-language commands that take actions or change configuration, details of what the conversational assistant can do, and independent hands-on corroboration.
